title: biosig-zarr format version 2: events group metadata document
description: The zarr.json of the events group of a format version 2 store, transcribed from spec/index.md at release 2.0.0, which is the definition. Rules that relate two values, such as n_events and the length of the event arrays, are not expressed. Unknown attributes are allowed.
$comment: Events group: the root group MUST contain a group named events.

zarr_format.$comment: Zarr requirements: a store MUST NOT use Zarr version 2 metadata.

node_type.$comment: Events group: events is a group.

attributes.$comment: Events group: the REQUIRED rows of the events attribute table.

label_map.description: Events group: a map from an event code, written as a decimal string, to its description.

propertyNames.$comment: Events group: an event code, written as a decimal string. The pattern checks the decimal form only; whether the value fits the int32 code array is not checked.

additionalProperties.$comment: Events group: the value is the code's description; the text gives no type, and a description is taken to be a string.
